name: 快递无人机

parameters.prompt: One complete stylized miniature cyberpunk object, faithfully reconstruct the supplied image. One small friendly cyberpunk courier drone: compact rounded graphite delivery body with cream cargo belly, four short arms ending in solid ducted rotor rings, two amber sensor eyes, restrained cyan status strips. Complete stationary rotors, no motion blur, smoke, package outside body or stand. Preserve silhouette, complete front/back/sides, connected solid shapes, clean textured metal, warm windows, colored trim. No background, ground plate, text, smoke, bloom halo, floating lights or baked shadows. Render-time lights will be added separately.

imageProvider: project configured OpenAI-compatible gpt-image-2 via bundled imagegen CLI
adoption: adopted after front/side/rear inspection; scene integration validated separately
